challenges.prompt: Implement revenueByCategory (total per category, sorted by name) and topCustomers (top n by total spend, ties by name, formatted name=12.34) with the Streams API, using the Order record. The program also prints summary statistics.
challenges.explain: groupingBy with a TreeMap and summingDouble builds the category totals; the customer ranking sorts map entries by value descending then key. Verified by running the solution with java Main.java.

challenges.title: A deadlock-free thread-safe transfer
challenges.prompt: Implement transfer(from, to, amount): lock both accounts (always the smaller id first), refuse overdrafts, move the money, and unlock in finally blocks. Run 2,000 concurrent opposite-direction transfers on a pool and check the total is preserved.
challenges.expected:
total preserved: true
overdraft refused: true
challenges.explain: Taking locks in a consistent global order removes the circular wait that causes deadlock, and finally blocks guarantee unlocking. The invariant (total balance) holds because each transfer is atomic. Verified by running the solution with java Main.java.
